title: Generator and regulator specifications
introduction:
I start with the engine and fitted generator option, then read that group’s pulley ratio, rating and regulator type together. The generator is a belt-driven power station, but the current named in an equipment heading is not a promise of that output at every speed. The rating row supplies the current-and-speed pairs to read.

Keep the base and optional groups distinct, and retain the amps, rpm and minimum/maximum labels attached to each rating. The table does not define the rpm reference or provide load, temperature or test setup. It is a specification reference rather than a standalone charging-system test or a replacement-selection guide.

edits.text: Specifications by engine and generator option
edits.why: Stay within the selected equipment group as you read down. Pulley ratio concerns the mechanical drive relationship; the rating pairs electrical current with stated speed; the regulator entry identifies its type and location. I keep those roles separate rather than treating a pulley ratio or equipment label as a measured charging result.
